svg.text: Assign the learner and test sign-in
Teaching diagram · not a screenshot or actual terminal result
AVD application group → Assignments; VM Access control (IAM)
Assign the intended Entra learner to the desktop application group using the supported Desktop
Virtualization User assignment. For an Entra-joined host, grant the required Virtual Machine
User Login permission at the appropriate narrow scope; admin sign-in is a different role.
If using direct personal assignment, assign that specific session host to the learner. Use a
supported Windows App or AVD web client to subscribe/sign in to the workspace with the licensed
Confirm the desktop starts without opening public 3389. If it fails, check application-group
assignment, VM login permissions, identity, MFA/session requirements and session-host health.
Do not fix it by making every learner an administrator.
Check: The assigned learner opens the intended personal desktop with scoped access.
